$description: The layout grid (library plan wave 1, foundation layout-grid): columns, gutters and margins per window class (Narrow, Medium, Wide), the contained width and the dev overlay. system/layout-grid.css draws .plx-layout-grid from them.

layout-grid-columns-narrow.$description: Layout grid: the columns on Narrow windows (under 600px).

layout-grid-gutter-narrow.$description: Layout grid: the space between columns on Narrow windows (under 600px).

layout-grid-margin-narrow.$description: Layout grid: the space at the start and end edges on Narrow windows (under 600px).

layout-grid-columns-medium.$description: Layout grid: the columns on Medium windows (600 to 839px).

layout-grid-gutter-medium.$description: Layout grid: the space between columns on Medium windows (600 to 839px).

layout-grid-margin-medium.$description: Layout grid: the space at the start and end edges on Medium windows (600 to 839px).

layout-grid-columns-wide.$description: Layout grid: the columns on Wide windows (840px and wider).

layout-grid-gutter-wide.$description: Layout grid: the space between columns on Wide windows (840px and wider).

layout-grid-margin-wide.$description: Layout grid: the space at the start and end edges on Wide windows (840px and wider).

layout-grid-contained-max.$description: Layout grid, contained: the widest the grid grows; it centers in wider windows.

layout-grid-overlay-opacity.$description: The grid overlay (platform/dev/grid-overlay.js): how strongly its columns show over the page.
